summary: The changes to the navigation, main heading, footer, and services list are intended, but the savings accounts card color was incorrectly changed from green to red/pink, contradicting the design language.

regressions.explanation: The Savings Accounts card background was changed from green to pink/red, which violates the soft pastel color grouping and was not requested in the design intent.
regressions.violated_rule: Soft pastel cards group related content; savings accounts card should not be changed.
